candidates.description: This feature vector represents historical references to twentieth-century European totalitarian regimes, particularly National Socialism and the Soviet Union.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai language characters and sub-word tokens.
These tokens primarily represent Thai script characters, sub-word components, and romanized linguistic fragments.
This vector activates for Thai consonant letters and character sequences commonly found in Thai text.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various preceding Thai vowels and tone marks.
These tokens commonly function as possessive markers, prepositions, or relational particles indicating origin, association, or belonging across multiple languages.
This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ว' (wo waen) and its various combinations with vowels, tone marks, and surrounding characters.
This vector represents subword tokens and abbreviations commonly associated with the Swahili language or related linguistic prefix patterns.
This feature vector represents European nationalities, languages, and geographic regions across multiple writing systems.
This feature represents governmental, national, or political entities and organizations.
